🌟 SearchPhone | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To perform comprehensive open-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations on a given phone number by aggregating data from various online sources and APIs.
✨ Key Features: • Phone Number Validation • Multiple Search Engines (Google, DuckDuckGo) • Code Repository Search (GitHub)
📖 Summary: SearchPhone is a Python-based OSINT toolkit designed to retrieve information linked to a phone number. It leverages multiple APIs including Google (via SerpAPI), DuckDuckGo, GitHub, Numverify, Reddit, and Hudson Rock to gather data, validate numbers, and check for infostealer compromises. The tool offers parallel processing for speed and generates automatic reports in JSON and PDF formats.
